Hi team,

Quick context: Headcount is approved for the Senior LLM Infra role (requisition GH-45678). Candidate Ethan Rogers (Tailwind.ai) has accepted in principle but has a competing offer from an EMEA-focused startup that is ~10% higher in base. He is willing to join Redwood if we can cover a small geo premium plus a one-time retention payment (to bridge 6 months). Hiring manager Rafael (copied via Greenhouse thread, not on this mailbox) recommends we do a limited exception to keep momentum — strong match for inference runtime team and immediate impact on our comp/cost tooling work.

Request: approval for the following out-of-band items for this hire (one-time exception, not precedent):
- Base: within band (Band 5, L5) — no change.
- Geo premium: one-time payment = EUR 12,000 (gross) to offset regional salary differential.
- Retention: one-time bridge payment = EUR 8,000 (gross) payable after 6 months.
- Equity: standard grant for band, but request a refresh clause at 12 months instead of 18 (manager rationale attached).

Attachments: Comp_Band_EU_Adjustments.xlsx (walks through market comps), Tailwind_Offer_v3.pdf (offer draft with the two one-time lines included).

Asks:
- Laura: finance/senior HR approval on the one-time payouts and the 12-month refresh clause.
- Markus: do we need an SLA/contract addendum for the retention payment tax handling (Earnings vs. Sign‑on)?
- Marissa: please confirm we have the headcount/role notes in Payroll to process EUR payments.

I need a decision within 24 hours — candidate is waiting on final numbers and has requested a formal offer by EOD Tuesday (their time).

Thanks,

2) Retention (EUR 8,000 after 6 months) — APPROVED pending HR tax handling confirmation.
3) Equity refresh timeline to 12 months — APPROVED but please cap to an explicit performance check (manager to confirm KPIs).
